stem: Magnesium nitrate, $\text{Mg(NO}_3\text{)}_2$, and strontium nitrate, $\text{Sr(NO}_3\text{)}_2$, both decompose when heated to form the metal oxide and a mixture of gases.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Write an equation for the thermal decomposition of $\text{Mg(NO}_3\text{)}_2$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
State which of $\text{Mg(NO}_3\text{)}_2$ or $\text{Sr(NO}_3\text{)}_2$ decomposes at a lower temperature.

Explain your answer.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Magnesium oxide, $\text{MgO}$, and strontium oxide, $\text{SrO}$, both react with dilute sulfuric acid.

$\text{MgO}$ forms a soluble salt, **A**.

$\text{SrO}$ forms an insoluble salt, **B**.
parts.text: Identify the products formed when $\text{MgO}$ reacts with dilute sulfuric acid.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why **A** is more soluble than **B**.
